earnings.title: AUTODESK, INC. ANNOUNCES FISCAL 2027 SECOND QUARTER RESULTS
highlights: Second quarter revenue grew 16 percent year over year as reported, 14 percent on a constant currency basis, to $2.05 billion

quotes.text: AI turns connected data and context into actionable project intelligence that can ease endemic capacity constraints, raise the bar on what’s possible in the physical world, and help our customers do more with scarce resources.
We delivered strong second quarter results with consistent execution and momentum. Our sales reorganization is proceeding as expected.

items.heading: Our strategy to develop and introduce new products and services exposes us to risks such as limited customer acceptance (both with new and existing customers), costs related to product defects, and large expenditures, each of which may result in no additional net revenue or decreased net revenue.
